title: Join a Discord voice channel
body:
Implement the ability for the bot to join the voice channel of the user who invoked the command.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Bot joins the invoking user's current voice channel
- Reports a clear error if the user isn't in a voice channel
- Raises a SessionStarted domain event on join

title: Leave a Discord voice channel
body:
Implement the ability for the bot to leave its current voice channel and cleanly end the session.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Bot disconnects from the voice channel on command
- Raises a SessionEnded-equivalent flow that flushes any pending audio

title: Receive raw voice packets per participant
body:
Capture incoming voice data from the Discord voice channel, keeping each participant's audio stream separate.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Audio is captured per speaking participant, not mixed into a single stream
- Raises ParticipantJoined/ParticipantLeft events as people enter/leave the channel

title: Implement Voice Activity Detection
body:
Detect when a participant starts and stops speaking, so silence isn't sent downstream for transcription.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- SpeakerStarted/SpeakerStopped events raised per participant
- False positives from background noise are reasonably filtered

title: Buffer and persist captured audio per participant
body:
Store each participant's captured audio segments to disk (or another configurable File Storage adapter) for later processing and, optionally, replay.

**Acceptance Criteria**
- Audio segments are written through the File Storage interface, not directly to disk from Core
- Segments are associated with their session and participant
